# `<e-status-pill>`

<!-- No screenshot found. Run the screenshots test to generate one. -->

Single-value status pill with a symbol-and-text cue.

> Source: [status-pill.ts](./status-pill.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `string` | `'neutral'` | Status key. One of the built-in `ok`/`warning`/`critical`/`offline`/`neutral`, or any key declared in `statuses`. |
| `statuses` | `string` | — | JSON map of status keys to `{symbol, label}`, merged over the built-ins. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Overrides the label text for the current status. |
| `size` | `'sm'\|'md'\|'lg'` | `'md'` | Type scale. `lg` reads across a room. |
| `announce` | `boolean` | — | Exposes the pill as a polite live region so a status change is announced. |

## Events

_None._

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _(default)_ | Optional text label, used when no `label` attribute is set. |
